asset.description: the physical machine or tool the row is about

category.description: plant/equipment category or type (free text or taxonomy code)

charge_rate.description: the tenant's hire/charge rate for the asset

condition.description: observed condition state and the date it was recorded

current_location.description: where the asset is currently held/assigned

custodian.description: the person currently responsible for the asset

design_standard.description: the published design standard the lifting plant was built to

next_service_due.description: date the next service/inspection falls due

occurred_at.description: the observation/harvest timestamp of the register fact

rated_capacity.description: rated capacity / safe working load of lifting plant

registrable.description: whether the item is one that must be registered before use

registration_number.description: the item/design registration number issued by the regulator

scan_code.description: barcode / QR / tag value used to scan the asset

serial_number.description: manufacturer serial number; the chosen cross-source asset-convergence key

source_record_id.description: the source's own primary identifier for the record

source_system.description: which bound system emitted the record

status.description: operational state of the asset in the register
